fusions.name: Skewer Throw
fusions.desc: Throws a skewer that deals 5 damage, up to 1.6 times that at maximum range. You heal for 12% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Skewered and Served
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A thrust that deals 24 damage, leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Pointed Reach
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 50% further. You restore 10 health when you cast it.

fusions.name: Left for the Door
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a spear flies to the nearest enemy within 7 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Once every 5 seconds. Each kill restores 3 health.
